title: Successive partial sums of a mapped range
statement: Let $M$ be an additive monoid, let $f: br	o M$, and let $n,j$ be natural numbers with $j<n$. The sum of the first $j+1$ terms of the list $[f(0),f(1),\ldots,f(n-1)]$ equals the sum of its first $j$ terms plus $f(j)$.
